ranked.headline: Methods infer regulatory activity and chromatin contacts from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Regulatory inference tools are now coupled to expression, chromatin contact, and single-cell and spatial multi-omic data.

ranked.headline: Built-in spatial and regulatory structure in single-cell and spatial omics models
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell omics tools now encode niche, regulatory, and morphological structure within the model rather than as post hoc analysis.

ranked.headline: Deep models segment and quality-control gigapixel tissue images
ranked.summary: Recent preprints report faster whole-slide patch extraction and cellular-resolution tissue masks for gigapixel pathology images.

ranked.headline: Technical fidelity of RNA quantification across small, circular and edited transcripts
ranked.summary: Absolute sncRNA quantification, circRNA artifact analysis and repeat-aware editing pipelines expose how library chemistry shapes RNA measurements.

ranked.headline: Graph and generative models predict drug, gene, and cell-level biological relationships
ranked.summary: Graph learning now couples biomedical knowledge graphs with explainable paths and generative models for drug and gene prediction.

ranked.headline: Injecting structured biological priors into protein and drug representation learning
ranked.summary: Pretrained sequence and chemical embeddings are now paired with graph, ontology, and interaction priors across binding, interaction, and association tasks.

ranked.headline: Shared latent spaces align unpaired and weakly paired single-cell multi-omic data
ranked.summary: Weakly paired, unpaired, and partially observed single-cell multi-omic datasets now demand alignment objectives that tolerate missing correspondence between…

ranked.headline: Probabilistic models resolve alleles, variants, and causal loci across genomic datasets
ranked.summary: Neural, sparse, and uncertainty-aware statistical models now address single-cell trans-eQTLs, allele-level genotyping, and virus mixture quantification.

ranked.headline: Single-cell and spatial profiling resolves tumor subclonal architecture and cellular…
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics now expose subclonal tumor heterogeneity, including MSI status divergence between subclones in 15 of 49 tumors.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and algorithms for quantitative DIA and LFQ proteomics by LC-MS
ranked.summary: New DIA workflows, matching algorithms, and cross-platform LFQ benchmarks address quantification depth and workflow evaluation in LC-MS proteomics.

ranked.headline: Models predict how electric fields and stiffness steer single-cell migration
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published model use biophysical simulation to predict cell navigation under electric, mechanical, and geometric cues.

ranked.headline: Computational mapping of bacterial post-transcriptional and cis-regulatory elements
ranked.summary: Comparative genomics and language-model approaches now predict regulatory RNA and DNA elements across many bacterial species.

ranked.headline: Computational design of nucleic acid sequences for diagnostics and sensing
ranked.summary: Recent work applies machine learning and scalable algorithms to design RNA sensors, multiplex primers, and long ssDNA for diagnostic and therapeutic use.

ranked.headline: Models link chromatin marks and sequence features to transcription and mutation rates
ranked.summary: Growing ChIP-seq, methylation, accessibility and mutation datasets enable explainable models of genomic regulatory features.

ranked.headline: Web and pipeline tools couple genomic data to annotation, variant and drug analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications describe interactive, reproducible platforms spanning annotation QC, GWAS-to-network medicine and variant classification.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics and genomic models are being evaluated for feature selection and integration
ranked.summary: Multitask deep learning on UK Biobank proteomic and metabolomic data now improves cardiovascular risk prediction up to 15 years early.

ranked.headline: Single-cell regulatory maps couple cis-elements to cell-type transcriptional programs
ranked.summary: Multimodal single-nucleus atlases and deep learning models now link regulatory elements to gene expression at single-cell and sequence resolution.

ranked.headline: Model structure governs accuracy of time-dependent sequence evolution inference
ranked.summary: Recent work tests whether latent states, somatic division events, and selection alter the accuracy of time-dependent sequence evolution inference.

ranked.headline: Recombination and structural change reshape clonal and organellar genome architecture
ranked.summary: Recent pedigree, reanalysis, and comparative studies quantify how recombination and structural variation shape clonal and organellar genomes.

ranked.headline: AI structure models extended to protein conformational dynamics and ensemble sampling
ranked.summary: Structure-prediction models are now used to sample conformational changes, disordered ensembles, and RNA structure ensembles, not single static folds.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved assemblies extend to autopolyploids and phased cultivar genomes
ranked.summary: Long-read and Hi-C pipelines now yield near telomere-to-telomere autotetraploid genomes, enabling allele-aware analyses in polyploids.

ranked.headline: Graph and polymer models resolve 3D genome domains and interchromosomal contacts
ranked.summary: Hi-C graph metrics and polymer simulations now quantify sub-megabase interchromosomal and pairing-dependent domain structure in embryos and plants.

ranked.headline: Histology and graph models infer spatially resolved gene expression and tissue domains
ranked.summary: Histology-based and graph-based methods now predict and resolve spatial gene expression and tissue domains across Xenium, multi-slice, and pan-cancer data.

ranked.headline: Generative models condition molecular design on trajectories, spectra and phenotypes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple molecular generation with explanation feedback, spectra, co-folding representations, and transcriptomic-morphological profiles.

ranked.headline: Generative diffusion and flow models sample protein dynamics and antibody structures
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend generative models from static structures to microsecond MD trajectories, GPCR-ligand dynamics, and antibody design.

ranked.headline: Protein language models are repurposed for fitness prediction, latent design, and…
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test protein language model outputs against ProteinGym fitness and other established biological benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Physical models link chromatin architecture and DNA topology to gene regulation output
ranked.summary: Experimentally informed polymer and supercoiling models now predict chromatin organization and expression from genome architecture at high resolution.

ranked.headline: Lower-cost pipelines bring nanopore telomere-to-telomere assembly to population genomics
ranked.summary: Recent reports cut commercial genome processing from $100 to under $1 and reduce nanopore assembly compute, enabling recomputable pangenomics.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models link gene expression, growth and transitions across biological scales
ranked.summary: Mechanistic and multiscale models now forecast transitions, oscillations and yield from gene-level kinetics to tissue-scale dynamics.

ranked.headline: Automated pipelines and benchmarks advance microbial genome and resistance profiling
ranked.summary: Long-read assembly and pangenome-graph profiling now yield strain-resolved microbial genomes and taxonomy, while benchmarks test detection tool performance.

ranked.headline: Variant models are judged against baselines and multimodal genomic evidence
ranked.summary: Sequence-to-function and LLM models now face explicit baseline tests that expose modality-specific gaps in variant prediction.

ranked.headline: Software tools track dynamic interfaces, coevolving residues, and pKa shifts in proteins
ranked.summary: Recent open-source tools quantify residue-level interface dynamics, coevolution, and pKa changes from simulations and sequence alignments.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked computational methods for tandem repeats, copy-number variants, and…
ranked.summary: Dataset-specific evaluations now test genotyping of repeats and copy-number variants, plus gene-interaction detection, across large genome cohorts.

ranked.headline: TE-derived promoters show tissue-specific activity; TE dynamics shape non-model genomes
ranked.summary: Atlas of 26,056 TE-derived TSSs across 115 human RAMPAGE samples links element age to promoter activity.

ranked.headline: Evaluation design shapes reported performance of toxicity and activity prediction models
ranked.summary: Standardized benchmarks and explicit control of data splitting and random seeds are needed to judge predictive gains credibly.

ranked.headline: Biological ground truth used to constrain and test machine learning models of neural…
ranked.summary: Explicit biological ground truth and structure are increasingly used to evaluate machine learning models of neural activity and brain dynamics.

ranked.headline: Synonymous and missense variant resources extend pathogenicity prediction
ranked.summary: Saturation mutagenesis, structure-based scoring and synonymous variant databases now expand pathogenicity prediction beyond coding missense sites.

ranked.headline: MD and machine learning frameworks probe immune-checkpoint and signaling modulators
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair MD, ABC-based tumor modelling, and interpretable scRNA-seq deep learning to address immune-modulating interventions.

ranked.headline: Single-cell B cell transcriptomics yields a gene signature predicting antibody affinity
ranked.summary: Single-cell and mass spectrometry data now feed antibody sequencing benchmarks, panel design, and B cell affinity prediction.

ranked.headline: Browser and agent-driven tools standardize EV, transcriptomic and omics plotting workflows
ranked.summary: Multi-instrument EV measurements, multi-cohort transcriptomics and single-nucleus datasets now come with web, R, and agent-based analysis layers.
